back:
A build configuration (or build target) is a collection of project settings that control how the IDE builds the project: output name, search paths, debug info, optimization, etc.

Debug turns optimizations off and keeps debugging information -- larger and slower, much easier to debug. Use this while developing.

Release optimizes for size and performance and strips debug info. Use this to ship a program or to measure performance.
front: What is a build configuration? How do Debug and Release differ?
